name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs lets agents turn text into speech, work with voices, and create, test and review ElevenLabs voice agents and their conversations. Generated audio comes back as a short-lived download link. Each user signs in to their own ElevenLabs account through the browser, and each generation uses credits of that account.

prompts.text: Read this paragraph aloud with a calm ElevenLabs voice and give me the audio.
List my ElevenLabs voice agents and the voice each one uses.
Summarize the last ten conversations of my support voice agent.

apps.name: ElevenLabs
apps.description: Text to speech, voices, and voice agent management, over ElevenLabs' MCP server with browser sign-in.
